howItWorks.step1Title: 1. Measure with AI or Manual Input
howItWorks.step1Desc: Use your phone camera for an instant 3D body scan or enter your precise anthropometric measurements with our guided tutorial.
howItWorks.step2Desc: Browse curated portfolios, consult with top tailors over HD video fitting calls, select custom fabrics, and agree on milestones.
howItWorks.step3Desc: Your tailor crafts your custom garment with precision craftsmanship. Protected escrow payments release upon your 100% satisfaction.

modal.step1Details: Accurate measurements are the foundation of bespoke fashion. You can use our AI camera scanner for automatic landmark estimation in 60 seconds, or follow our guided interactive measurement guide.
modal.step1Tip: Tip: Wear fitted clothing and ensure good lighting for optimal scanner accuracy.
modal.step2Details: Find the ideal master artisan based on specialty, past bespoke creations, and verified client reviews. Schedule live HD video fitting sessions to discuss silhouette, fabrics, and deadlines.
modal.step2Tip: Tip: Share inspiration images, fabric preferences, and fitting milestones directly in chat.
modal.step3Details: Your custom garment is handcrafted with bespoke care. Escrow protection safeguards your payment—funds are only released when you receive your outfit and confirm 100% satisfaction.
modal.step3Tip: Tip: If adjustments are needed, our platform guarantees free alteration support.

photoGuide.modalSubtitle: Follow these 4 simple steps for tailored precision
photoGuide.zoomHint: Click image to view high-resolution photo guide
photoGuide.step1Desc: To calculate millimeter-accurate tailoring measurements, our AI requires clear visibility of your natural contours.
photoGuide.step1Check1: Wear tight-fitting activewear: Leggings, biker shorts, yoga pants, or a snug fitted shirt.
photoGuide.step1Check2: Tuck in your top: Ensure the waistband and hip joints are explicitly delineated.
photoGuide.step1Check3: Tie long hair up: Keep hair tied back off your neck, collarbone, and shoulders.
photoGuide.step1Avoid: Avoid loose/baggy clothes: Sweaters, oversized tees, hoodies, or robes will distort measurements.
photoGuide.step2Desc: Even lighting and high background contrast prevent shadow artifacts from masking your body silhouette.
photoGuide.step2Check1: Well-lit room: Turn on ambient ceiling or front-facing room lights to eliminate harsh cast shadows.
photoGuide.step2Check2: Plain, contrasting backdrop: Stand against a solid wall (e.g., dark clothing against a light wall).
photoGuide.step2Avoid: Avoid backlighting & windows behind you: Strong light behind turns you into a black outline and loses 3D depth.
photoGuide.step3Desc: Perspective distortion happens if the phone is tilted or too close. Keep the camera completely vertical.
photoGuide.step3Check1: Prop phone completely vertical (90°): Do not tilt phone backwards or forwards. Lean it against a mug, box, or phone stand.
photoGuide.step3Check2: Position at waist height: Place on a table or counter (~3 ft / 1 meter off the ground).
photoGuide.step3Check3: Step back ~2 meters (6–7 ft): Your entire body (from the top of your head to the soles of your feet) must be visible in frame.
photoGuide.step4FrontDesc: Face camera directly. Feet shoulder-width apart. Hold arms slightly away from sides (an 'A' shape) so waist outline is clear.
photoGuide.step4SideDesc: Turn 90° into profile. Stand upright with shoulders relaxed and chin level. Look straight ahead, arms at sides.
photoGuide.step4BackDesc: Face away from the camera. Replicate the same upright stance and arm gap as the Front Pose for shoulder/back width detection.
photoGuide.privacyGuaranteed: Privacy Guaranteed: Photos are strictly encrypted, processed by AI measurement algorithms, and never shared publicly.

instructionsModal.title: How to Measure Yourself Accurately
instructionsModal.subtitle: Follow these industry-standard tailoring guidelines for a flawless bespoke fit
instructionsModal.tip1: Use a flexible cloth or vinyl measuring tape, not metal ruler.
instructionsModal.tip2: Keep the tape snug against the body, but not pulling tight into skin.
instructionsModal.tip3: Maintain normal upright posture and breathe naturally.
